column1: # Calibration runs against other platforms are internal and are not published:
# Provenance note: this run was produced by a generator whose verdict tokens
# were Spanish (LIMPIO / INVALIDO) and whose reason strings were Spanish too.
# Both were translated when the repository was prepared for public release.
# Every count, rate and lag figure is byte-identical to what the run produced;
# only the labels changed. Recorded here rather than left implicit, because
# silently editing measurement output is how evidence stops being evidence.
